score.note: The coherent video/DMA translation unit preserves the 64-byte extent and aligned instruction stream. The residual is two adjacent instruction-order swaps in the owner head. This candidate claims zero DONE bytes.

family.difference: Direct ROM comparison finds no body difference outside the delay materialization at owner offsets 0x28 and 0x2a; the 0x20000 sibling changes only one of those halfwords. Every other instruction and both pool words agree.

cross_edition.note: Each of the nine relocation-bearing candidates uniquely locates one 64-byte owner in every edition; all 54 comparisons have zero core differences.

domain: Queues one memory-mapped write and its destination for delayed execution while preserving interrupt-master state.
expressed: interrupt-master save, disable spelling, and restore

remaining.where: the coherent unit emits the argument save before the queue-base load and the interrupt-master save after its disable store; the reference uses the opposite order at both sites

rejected_experiments.result: no candidate improved the allocation residual or reached zero

rejected_experiments.result: all either retained the pointer swap or introduced extra loads, spills, or prologue registers

rejected_experiments.result: against the earlier isolated-owner source, none reached zero; seven preserved its 13-halfword allocation residual, -fno-cse-skip-blocks regressed to 29, and -fno-schedule-insns2 still differed in 10 halfwords

rejected_experiments.experiment: joint family transfer through one shared body and nine constant-only wrappers
rejected_experiments.result: the earlier wrapper-only reconstruction left all nine at 13 differing halfwords. Reconstructing the complete surrounding translation unit later reduced every sibling to the current four-halfword ordering residual under canonical flags

rejected_experiments.experiment: joint declaration, integer-width, queue-view, raw-pointer, IME-pointer, early-destination, compiler-family, optimization, CSE, GCSE, scheduler, strength-reduction, regmove, and expensive-optimization matrix
rejected_experiments.result: no isolated source/compiler pairing reached zero. This result predates the complete translation-unit reconstruction and is retained only as evidence that per-owner flag searches did not explain the reference.

rejected_experiments.experiment: complete-unit follow-up over the shared nine-owner macro: canonical scheduling, both scheduler toggles, regmove, CSE-follow, CSE-skip, expensive-optimization, declaration/scope order, register hints, direct-global access, and a shared inline helper
rejected_experiments.result: the representative 0800383c owner remained at the canonical four-halfword ordering residual for every neutral flag and register-hint variant; -fno-schedule-insns2 regressed to eight, declaration/scope variants regressed to thirteen, the inline helper to twenty-three, and direct-global access to twenty-five. The shared source shape therefore remains the best bounded whole-unit result.

rejected_experiments.experiment: complete-unit GCC scheduler-priority audit of the shared macro
rejected_experiments.result: all nine owners have the same two source-ordering residuals: the queue literal load and destination preservation tie at priority 9, so canonical GCC selects the preservation first; after the interrupt-master load, the saved value copy has priority 4 while the disable store has priority 5, so GCC selects the store first. Neutral ordinary-C declaration, width, pointer, initializer, and control-flow variants did not change that graph or regressed.

next: Keep the coherent translation unit as measured reconstruction evidence. A future family candidate must preserve the 64-byte extent, literal pools, and all-nine agreement while producing queue-literal-before-destination preservation and saved-IME-copy-before-disable-store under canonical GCC; do not relabel this bounded scheduler tie as a compiler limitation.
